status: C1 core local implementation; isolated migration API; not production
transport_gate: Every /internal/c1 route is absent in production and requires C1_TEST_KEY in local or staging. This gate is separate from the business authentication declared per action.

response.envelope: Common Cloudflare success/failure envelope with request correlation and backend identity.
response.write: data contains operation:{action,request_id,committed_at} and immutable result. Replay returns the same stored data.
response.read: data is a current projection with generated_at when time matters.

/internal/c1/import-core.notes: Full core shadow snapshot. Preserves legacy Coach credential digests and stable IDs. Upserts only equal or newer entity versions; never interprets an omitted row as deletion; creates no Google outbox.

/internal/c1/coach-login.notes: Validates a migrated legacy Code digest. New session tokens bind backend_generation and writer_epoch; no old session is migrated.

/internal/c1/create-season.notes: Creates a DRAFT season with a deterministic stable ID and a pending CORE_CHANGED outbox row. Does not activate or bind Google.

/internal/c1/update-member.notes: Requires an OPEN season and exact member version. Updates roster version and creates a pending CORE_CHANGED outbox row in the same transaction.

/internal/c1/public-roster.notes: The isolated transport gate still applies. Only active member ID, effective display name, default preference and member version are projected.
